sources.title: TinyLlama: An Open-Source Small Language Model - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Abstract We present TinyLlama, a compact 1.1B language model pretrained on around 1 trillion tokens for up to 3 epochs 1. Building on the architecture and tokenizer of Llama 2 (Touvron et al., 2023b), TinyLlama leverages various advances contributed by the open-source community, e.g., FlashAttention (Dao, 2023) and Lit-GPT (Lightning-AI, 2023), achieving better computational efficiency ...

sources.title: TinyLlama: An Open-Source Small Language Model - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Our TinyLlama is open-source, aimed at improving accessibility for researchers in language model research. We believe its excellent performance and compact size make it an attractive platform for researchers and practitioners in language model research.

sources.title: tinyllama
sources.snippet: TinyLlama is a compact model with only 1.1B parameters. This compactness allows it to cater to a multitude of applications demanding a restricted computation and memory footprint.
